directories.name: Justdial
submission_steps: Go to justdial.com/Add-Listing
Search for Prime Bridge Media — if exists, claim it
Fill NAP exactly as in canonical block (paste, don't retype)
Select categories: Marketing Services (primary) + + Website Designers + Internet Marketing Service
Set hours: Mon-Sat 10:00-19:00
Upload logo + 5-10 photos
Answer verification call within 24-48h
common_rejections: Business name contains best or superlatives
Address isn't a real physical location
post_submit_actions: Claim ownership after listing goes live
Complete Products/Services section
Add photos + cover image

directories.name: Sulekha
submission_steps: Go to sulekha.com/add-business
Choose primary category: Marketing Services > Digital Marketing
Fill NAP from canonical
Add 4 service listings (Local SEO, YouTube Ads, Meta Ads, WordPress)
Upload logo + photos
Verify via hello@primebridgemedia.com email
post_submit_actions: Complete every field
Add each service as separate listing
Upload all photos

directories.name: Google Business Profile (Chandigarh)
submission_steps: Go to business.google.com
Sign in with the same Google account that owns the GMB
Create listing: Prime Bridge Media
Address: Sector 17, Chandigarh, India 160017
Phone: +91-XXXXXXXXXX
Category: Marketing agency (primary) + Internet marketing service + Website designer + Advertising agency
Use 750-char Chandigarh description from launch pack
Upload logo + cover photo + 10+ business photos
Verify by phone/SMS if available, else postcard
common_rejections: PO Box or virtual office address
post_submit_actions: Respond to every review within 24h
Post weekly updates (3 per week)
Add Q&A entries

directories.name: Google Business Profile (Mohali / PKL / ZKP)
directories.verification_method: 3 separate GMB listings — one per city
submission_steps: Create 3 additional listings: Mohali, Panchkula, Zirakpur
Same canonical NAP except service area emphasis
Each uses city-specific 750-char description from launch pack
Verify each separately (3 postcards OR 3 phone verifications)
common_rejections: Google flags as duplicate if categories are identical across all 4
post_submit_actions: Track each listing separately in GBP tab
Post city-specific content (12 posts total = 3 per listing)

directories.name: IndiaMART
directories.category: Marketing Services > Digital Marketing Services (Service Provider)
submission_steps: Go to indiamart.com/joinus/
CRITICAL: Choose Service Provider (NOT Product Seller)
Category: Marketing Services > Digital Marketing Services
Fill NAP from canonical
Service title: Digital Marketing Services - Local SEO, YouTube Ads, Meta Ads, WordPress
Service description: Long version (750 chars) from launch pack
post_submit_actions: Skip TrustSeal paid option (₹30K/year not needed for citations)
Add catalog of all 4 services

directories.name: Bing Places
submission_steps: Sign in with Microsoft account (create outlook.com if needed)
Click Add new business
RECOMMENDED: Import from Google Business Profile (pulls photos/hours/categories automatically)
If importing manually: fill NAP from canonical
Verify by phone (faster) if available
post_submit_actions: Verify import pulled all photos correctly
Submit sitemap to Bing Webmaster

directories.name: Apple Maps (Business Connect)
submission_steps: Sign in with Apple ID (create if needed)
Click Add a Business
Fill NAP from canonical
Category: Marketing Agency
Add logo + cover photo (Apple is strict on visual quality)
Verify via email + phone
post_submit_actions: Approval takes 3-7 days — flag if not live by Day 10
Verify Siri surfaces the listing

directories.name: Practo
submission_steps: Go to practo.com/claim
Click For Business > Claim your listing
Category: Healthcare Marketing / Clinic Marketing Service
Use VERTICAL-SPECIFIC description (clinics) from launch pack
Add services: Local SEO for clinics, Meta ads for doctors, Clinic website design
Verify by phone
common_rejections: Service-only businesses sometimes rejected — backup plan: build vertical landing page
post_submit_actions: Listings take 3-5 days — don't be alarmed by delay
Update bio with PBM website + services

directories.name: 99acres
directories.category: Real estate marketing service (NOT property lister)
submission_steps: Sign up as service provider (NOT property lister)
Use VERTICAL-SPECIFIC description (real estate) from launch pack
Add services: Local SEO for real estate, Meta ads for builders, YouTube walkthroughs, Builder websites
Verify by phone + email
post_submit_actions: Backup plan: build vertical landing page and re-try

directories.name: Yelp India
submission_steps: Sign up as business at biz.yelp.com/signup
Fill NAP from canonical
Categories: Marketing Agency + Advertising + Web Design
Add 5+ photos
Verify by phone
common_rejections: First 1-2 reviews get filtered as Not Recommended — reappear after activity
post_submit_actions: Don't be alarmed if early reviews are filtered
Encourage check-ins + photos from visitors

global_checklist.task: Confirm canonical NAP block finalised (phone + address locked)
Logo + cover photo ready in /assets folder
Microsoft + Apple IDs created and tested
Verification calls/SMS answered within 24h of receipt
NAP audit run on Day 14 — verify all 10 listings show same NAP
Add 2 more directories: TradeIndia + Foursquare (Phase 2, days 14-30)
Add 5+ niche-specific directories per top niche (Phase 2)
